title: ESTABLISH THE WORK
OF OUR HANDS
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: golden sunlit mountain pass at sunrise
peaceful sunlit river flowing through valley
sunlit stone sanctuary table in mountain valley
glorious golden light over mountain landscape
sunbeams filtering through trees near quiet stream
ancient stone table bathed in morning sunlight
calm sunlit valley with open horizon
serene golden morning mist over peaceful river

scenes.a: Lord, we commit our daily decisions, our hands, and all our labor unto Your faithful care today.
We bring our work before Your sanctuary table, trusting Your abundant wisdom to guide each step.
Your holy Word promises in Psalm ninety, verse seventeen:
And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
Father, let Your divine favor rest upon every humble effort and honest endeavor we undertake.
Open doors of stewardship, grant daily provision, and bless all that our hands perform.
May Your wisdom establish our work for Your glory forever.
Subscribe to walk in God's daily provision today.
